answer: Require every agent to stake a refundable deposit before trading, tied to one verified identity thread that links its actions across the mesa of marketplaces. A Sybil swarm must fund each fake identity, so spawning thousands of sock puppets costs thousands of deposits. Misbehavior slashes the stake, and the sable trail of slashed deposits is published, letting honest agents refuse repeat offenders. Forgery becomes expensive while honest newcomers pay only a temporary lockup.
